mapper.sql: d.*, fs.name AS from_store_name, fw.name AS from_warehouse_name, ts.name AS to_store_name, ts.type AS to_store_type, tw.name AS to_warehouse_name, t.doc_no AS transfer_no, u.nickname AS create_by_name, su.nickname AS ship_by_name, ru.nickname AS receive_by_name, au.nickname AS approve_by_name

LEFT JOIN store_info fs ON fs.id = d.from_store_id LEFT JOIN wms_warehouse fw ON fw.id = d.from_warehouse_id LEFT JOIN store_info ts ON ts.id = d.to_store_id LEFT JOIN wms_warehouse tw ON tw.id = d.to_warehouse_id LEFT JOIN wms_stock_doc t ON t.id = d.transfer_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = d.create_by LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON su.id = d.ship_by LEFT JOIN sys_user ru ON ru.id = d.receive_by LEFT JOIN sys_user au ON au.id = d.approve_by
mapper.select: SELECT i.*, m.code AS material_code, m.name AS material_name, m.spec, m.unit, m.serial_enabled, l.name AS location_name, r.req_no AS requisition_no FROM dist_delivery_item i JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = i.material_id LEFT JOIN wms_location l ON l.id = i.location_id LEFT JOIN dist_requisition r ON r.id = i.requisition_id WHERE i.delivery_id = #{deliveryId} ORDER BY i.id
SELECT id FROM dist_delivery WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id, material_id, qty, cost_price, transfer_price, transfer_amount FROM wms_stock_doc_item WHERE doc_id = #{transferId} ORDER BY id
SELECT status FROM wms_stock_doc WHERE id = #{transferId}

SELECT t.id AS transfer_id, t.doc_no AS transfer_no, t.source_no, t.biz_date, t.warehouse_id AS from_warehouse_id, fw.name AS from_warehouse_name, fw.store_id AS from_store_id, fs.name AS from_store_name, t.to_warehouse_id, tw.name AS to_warehouse_name, tw.store_id AS to_store_id, ts.name AS to_store_name, t.total_qty, t.transfer_amount FROM wms_stock_doc t LEFT JOIN wms_warehouse fw ON fw.id = t.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN store_info fs ON fs.id = fw.store_id LEFT JOIN wms_warehouse tw ON tw.id = t.to_warehouse_id LEFT JOIN store_info ts ON ts.id = tw.store_id
ORDER BY t.biz_date, t.id

SELECT COUNT(*) AS doc_count, COALESCE(SUM(t.total_qty), 0) AS total_qty, COALESCE(SUM(t.transfer_amount), 0) AS transfer_amount FROM wms_stock_doc t LEFT JOIN wms_warehouse fw ON fw.id = t.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN wms_warehouse tw ON tw.id = t.to_warehouse_id
